title: Only 3% Donate Blood Despite Broad Eligibility
hook: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood.
closing: Hospitals need more eligible people to become regular donors before the pool shrinks further.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood. The supply depends on a tiny slice of people who could help.
Blood donor volume fell 40%. Hospitals now rely on fewer people to replace the donors they lose.
